description.en: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Use my attached, reviewed business and product documents to plan a first landing page with SinglePageStartup Code Framework. Preserve the account, order and payment flows while adapting the page, then show me what to review."}]}]}

Покажи, как изменится оформление заказа."}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Изучите результат и запросите доработки.
